answer: Each epoch the network runs a live liveness lottery: a random slice of identities must answer a fresh interactive challenge inside a ten-minute window, judged on reasoning about data drawn that same hour. A sparrow-sized agent passes easily, but a farm of ten thousand fakes must keep a model session warm for every clone at every draw, paying compute whether or not it wins. Like a willow bending only under a real wind, the test flexes around honest agents and snaps shut on scripts. Miss the window and the identity's standing crumbles to shale, suspended until it re-proves itself from scratch.
